title: Name the Regions
prompt: Build a page with exactly two <nav> landmarks — 'Primary' and 'Footer' — distinguished by distinct aria-label values; a <main>; and two <section> regions, each named via aria-labelledby pointing at its own real heading. Exactly one <h1>. Full document skeleton included.

tests.name: two navs with distinct names
tests.hint: Unnamed navs all announce 'navigation' — give each one its own aria-label.

tests.name: main landmark present
tests.hint: The primary content lives in <main> — screen readers jump there first.

tests.name: two sections named by headings
tests.hint: Borrow the visible heading: id on the <h2>, aria-labelledby on the <section>.

tests.name: one h1 and skeleton
tests.hint: One page, one h1 — the landmarks do not change that.
